entities.title: Every effect on the machine goes through one trait
entities.summary: Commands, name lookups, TCP connections, waiting, the clock, SSH detection and the Wi-Fi watchdog all go through the Sys trait in sys.rs.
entities.context: The tool reads and changes a Mac's network, and its repair steps can cut the connection; the tests must exercise gathering, diagnosis, every repair step and both commands without touching a real network.
entities.decision: One Sys trait with a real implementation (Real) and a scripted Mac for tests (fake::Fake); no other module runs a process or opens a socket.
entities.rationale: The tests can drive the whole tool against a scripted Mac, and the real implementation separately against localhost.
entities.origin: Moved from the second bullet of Limitations in macos/rust/fix-network/README.md.

entities.title: Judge Wi-Fi association by the address, not the SSID
entities.summary: The tool decides whether Wi-Fi is usable from the interface's addresses and never asks for the network name.
entities.context: networksetup -getairportnetwork is unreliable on recent macOS.
entities.decision: Use the interface's IPv4 or global IPv6 address from ifconfig, and the radio power from networksetup -getairportpower.
entities.rationale: An address is a reliable sign the Mac has joined a working network; the reported SSID is not.

entities.title: How long run directories are kept
entities.summary: Every run leaves a directory with its log and the original settings under the state root, and nothing ever removes them.
entities.context: Session::at creates a new timestamped directory per run (diagnostic.log, original.json, and recover.sh after a Wi-Fi cycle); no code deletes old ones, and neither the README nor the skill says whether they should be kept forever.

options.title: Keep every run
options.consequences: Full history for diagnosis; the directories grow without bound.

options.title: Prune runs older than a set age or beyond a set count
options.consequences: Bounded space; old original settings are lost.

origin.description: Found while documenting the folder: the code never removes run directories.
